title: Tidey Whitey - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach West,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…"Tidey Whitey", a luxurious Seacrest Beach West retreat featuring a private heated pool, spa, and a charming carriage house. Accommodating up to 14 guests, this home offers a chef’s kitchen with top-tier appliances, multiple living areas, and expansive porches overlooking the pool. Just a short walk to prime beach access and close to Alys and Rosemary Beach, it's the perfect destination for families or groups seeking a premium 30A getaway.*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to the Beach: Just a short walk to Seacrest West's pristine white sands.Private Heated Pool & Spa: Enjoy a luxurious 34x16 ft pool with a bubbling spa.Carriage House: Includes a king bedroom, bunk room, full kitchen, and living space.Chef’s Kitchen: Equipped with quartz countertops, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf range, and 8’ island.Spacious Living Areas: Open-concept design with shiplap paneling and multiple gathering spaces.Outdoor Kitchen & Grill Area: Perfect for al fresco dining and entertaining.Expansive Porches: Multiple furnished decks overlooking the pool.Beach Bikes: Includes 7 adult bikes for exploring the scenic 30A trails.Proximity to Attractions: Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and The Hub for shopping and dining.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The property was exactly as described—spacious, clean, and just a short walk to the beach. Perfect for large groups!" – Michael S.⭐ "Beautiful home with excellent amenities. We loved the pool and proximity to shops and restaurants!" – Jenna L.⭐ "Tidey Whitey was everything we hoped for—a relaxing and luxurious getaway. Highly recommend!" – Amir R.*** YOUR 30A BEACH ESCAPE ***Experience unparalleled luxury at "Tidey Whitey", where modern amenities meet coastal charm. This vacation home in Seacrest Beach West, professionally decorated by the infamous 2 Hags Swag, was built by Romair Construction—both renowned for their quality craftsmanship and beachy chic décor.Unwind in abundant indoor and outdoor spaces, by the private heated pool and spa, or prepare gourmet meals in the state-of-the-art kitchen. With plenty of room and generous parking, it’s ideal for bigger groups without compromising privacy. Choose from 4 main house bedrooms or retreat to the serene carriage house for added privacy. With prime beach access just a short stroll away and close proximity to vibrant local communities, this home offers the quintessential 30A experience.*** LIVING AREAS ***Main Living Area: Open-concept space with comfortable seating, large TV, and coastal-inspired decor.Second Living Area (Loft): Cozy couches, a Smart TV, and additional relaxation space.Carriage House: Full kitchen and living area with modern appliances and comfortable seating.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Chef’s Kitchen: Quartz countertops, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf range, and farm sink.Dining Area: Spacious dining table with seating for the whole family.Outdoor Kitchen: Grill and prep area for al fresco dining experiences.*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Private Pool & Spa: Perfect for your enjoyment. Pool is heated September-April.Furnished Decks: Multiple porches with comfortable seating.Spacious Pool Deck: Plenty of space for outdoor fun and relaxation.Outdoor Grilling Area: Fully equipped with a grill and prep space, ideal for al fresco dining.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Main House:First FloorHalf Bathroom: Conveniently located off the kitchen.Primary Suite: King bed, large TV, en suite bathroom with soaking tub, walk-in shower and double vanity.Second FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, TV, en suite bathroom.King Guest Suite: King bed, TV, shared bathroom.Bunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds, perfect for children.Carriage House:King Suite: King bed, large TV, en suite bathroom with walk-in shower.Bunk Room: Twin-over-twin bunk beds with pocket door for privacy.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Beach Access: Just a short walk to Seacrest West's stunning white sands.Nearby Communities: Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and The Hub for shopping and dining.Quiet Neighborhood: Ideal for a serene and relaxing getaway.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Protection: Travel protection is NOT included in our quotes but can be purchased during check-out or obtained independently.No Wire Transfers: VERY IMPORTANT - WE DO NOT ACCEPT WIRE TRANSFERS.Beach Bikes: This property includes 7 bikes for guest use. A waiver must be signed before use, and additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Event Policy: This is not an event-friendly property.Pool Heating: Pools are heated between the dates of September 1st - April 30th.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 99614STRO #: STR-099614

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
